title: PublishSchedule
description: The accepted time, tied to a draft, in a state a downstream runtime can update. This object is deliberately thin — it records a decision and its provenance, and it schedules nothing. Reminders, queueing and actual publishing are App services. Its one hard rule is that it must never launder a refusal into a recommendation: a creator may schedule any time they like, but when the engine abstained, the resulting schedule carries source 'creator_choice_not_recommended' and no confidence.

recommendation_ref.description: The PublishRecommendation this decision was taken against, whether it recommended or abstained.

draft_ref.description: The Draft / SelectedIdea / ScriptPackage this time belongs to. Without it a schedule cannot be attributed back to the content that was planned, which is what post-result learning needs later.

zone.description: IANA zone the creator sees this time in; null when no usable creator zone was supplied.

source.description: Where the time came from. 'engine_recommended' is only permitted when the referenced recommendation has outcome 'recommended' and the time falls inside one of its windows. When the engine abstained, a creator may still schedule — that is their call — but it is recorded as their choice, never as advice.

confidence.description: Carried over from the recommendation. Must be null whenever source is not 'engine_recommended'.

state.description: proposed: offered to the creator. accepted: the creator agreed to this time. scheduled: a runtime holds it. published: it went out. abandoned: dropped without publishing.

state_history.description: Append-only. A schedule that changed silently cannot be audited later against the post result.

published_result_ref.description: Set once the post exists. Post-result learning will read this to close the loop; that loop is not implemented here and requires the shared state store plus an owner refresh.
